messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: metering-high-error-rate triggered for billing-emitter (P1) - see runbook link <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-emitter>
alex: I'm on it, taking the on-call handoff. seeing a sudden spike in duplicate token emits and late windows. rx count +120% in the last 5m.
sana: exact symptom? duplicates, replay, or latency?
alex: looks like both. emitter lagging -> retries -> dup keys in ledger, plus delayed kafka batches. snippet from emitter logs:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z WARN emitter.replay duplicate_msg_id=abcd1234 topic=usage.v1 retry_count=3
2026-03-18T09:12:05Z ERROR writer.commit timeout partition=12 offset=4821
```
jamal: billing-bot reported multiple overage flags for customers on yesterday's window — could be correlated.
maya: I'm seeing spike in shadow counts too (shadow-agg). aggregator backlog shows many late messages landing in midnight window.
alex: immediate mitigation: pause emitter auto-retries and flip to passthrough (no dedupe) to stop replays. scheduling a controlled disable now.
ops_lead: hold customer-impact comms until we confirm scope. try quick reconcile first to avoid noisy emails.
sana: quick check: can we run live recon for the last hour to see inflight vs ledger? I can kick off a job.
alex: kicked live-recon job ID lr-20260318-01
jamal: moving to canary: disable emitter retries for one partition set, confirm deltas.
maya: recon job progress: 12% - mismatch in token totals across emit->ingest for accounts A,B,C. probable double-counting from retries.
billing-bot: ALERT: 57 accounts flagged for potential overage escalation. threshold=50.
alex: good to know. I'm going to temporarily silence the overage flagging rule for 20m (to prevent customer noise) while we confirm.
ops_lead: document the silence and who authorized (alex). we need rollback plan in 15m.
sana: recon job output (excerpt):
```
account A: emitter_emits=12438 ledger_count=12438 ingestion_duplicates=342
account B: emitter_emits=8901 ledger_count=8860 ingestion_duplicates=41
```
maya: looks like duplicates concentrated on certain emitter hosts - likely GC pause causing retries + kafka acks lag.
jamal: proposed next steps: 1) keep suppression on 20m; 2) backfill dedupe job to remove dup spikes from billing ledger for affected windows; 3) resume retries in paused mode with lower retry ceiling; 4) prepare customer-facing note if backfill will alter invoices.
alex: executing step 1 and 3 (partial) now. also enabling detailed tracing for the affected emitter hosts.
ops_lead: assign owners: backfill = sana, dedupe script = jamal, customer-impact draft = maya. ETA 2h for backfill dry-run.
sana: starting backfill dry-run against staging ledger to validate dedupe script.
maya: drafting customer note: short, technical, reassurance that we will not bill duplicates and we will notify if invoices change. ping me if you see high-risk accounts.
billing-bot: NOTE: billing pipeline flagged incremental adjustments if dedupe applied. will hold invoice generation for affected accounts until final ok.
alex: quick status in 10m. if excessive customer-risk (>100 accounts) we escalate to legal/ops for external notice.
maya: also logging incident to postmortem queue: incident-mtr-20260318.
jamal: early hypothesis: emitter retry policy + broker latency + partial commit on writer -> replay. I'll open PR to add stronger idempotency token enforcement during commit.
ops_lead: good. after backfill dry-run and small sample reconciliation, we'll decide on wider suppression window. keep thread updates concise.
alex: update: backfill dry-run shows dedupe removes ~95% of duplicates in staging window. proceeding to schedule production backfill in 30m (low-traffic window).
maya: customer-impact estimate: ~62 accounts touched, median surplus tokens per account ~420, highest ~12k. We'll prepare individualized outreach if invoice delta > $1000.
alex: thanks. holding suppression until we confirm backfill success. posting update to #general after production run completes. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by alex. Next update due 10m from thread_ts.
